2608.25977.title: When Personality Meets Quantization: A Layer-wise MBTI Analysis of Quantized LLMs
2608.25977.paper_summary: Personality is increasingly important in large language models (LLMs), as it shapes users' trust, engagement, and emotional experiences. While the Myers--Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI) has emerged as a common framework for assessing LLMs' personality, existing studies focus primarily on full-precision models and evaluate only final outputs. They overlook the widespread deployment of quantized LLMs requiring low memory footprints, whose personality traits remain underexplored. In this work, we present a systematic MBTI analysis of open-source LLMs across multiple precisions, including mainstream 4-bit methods (GPTQ, AWQ) and extreme 2-bit settings (AQLM variants). Beyond output-level evaluation, we examine how personality emerges across layers through option-level entropy and confidence-gap dynamics, and introduce Uncertainty-Amplified Layer Decoding (UALD) to study decoding-induced personality drift at inference time. Our results reveal a key insight: LLMs' personality is not a static property, but an emergent, layer-dependent decision process sensitive to quantization, prompting, and decoding. Specifically, we find that (1) ENFJ remains dominant across model families and precisions; (2) 4-bit quantization largely preserves coarse personality structure, while 2-bit quantization disrupts fine-grained prompt consistency and cross-precision agreement; (3) personality decisions emerges in upper layers, following substantial ambiguity in early layers; and (4) inference decoding can shift personality, while personality-aligned conditioning improves robustness. These findings provide a new perspective on the behavioral reliability of quantized LLMs and highlight the importance of considering internal dynamics and inference strategies in personality-sensitive chatbot applications.
2608.25977.paper_summary_zh: 個性在大型語言模型（LLMs）中越來越重要，因為它影響用戶的信任、參與度和情感體驗。雖然邁爾斯-布里格斯性格指標（MBTI）已成為評估LLMs個性的一個常見框架，但現有研究主要集中於全精度模型，僅評估最終輸出。它們忽略了需要低內存佔用的量化LLMs的廣泛部署，而這些模型的個性特徵仍然未被充分探索。在本研究中，我們對多種精度的開源LLMs進行系統的MBTI分析，包括主流的4位元方法（GPTQ、AWQ）和極端的2位元設置（AQLM變體）。除了輸出層級的評估外，我們還檢查了個性如何通過選項級熵和信心差動態在各層中出現，並引入不確定性放大層解碼（UALD）來研究推理時解碼引起的個性漂移。我們的結果揭示了一個關鍵見解：LLMs的個性不是一個靜態屬性，而是一個依賴於層次的決策過程，對量化、提示和解碼敏感。具體而言，我們發現：（1）ENFJ在各模型家族和精度中仍然佔主導地位；（2）4位元量化在很大程度上保留了粗略的個性結構，而2位元量化則破壞了細緻的提示一致性和跨精度一致性；（3）個性決策在上層出現，早期層中存在相當大的模糊性；（4）推理解碼可以改變個性，而與個性對齊的條件則提高了穩健性。這些發現為量化LLMs的行為可靠性提供了一個新的視角，並強調了在對個性敏感的聊天機器人應用中考慮內部動態和推理策略的重要性。
